pages.title: Comandos Principais
pages.text: $(o)/liberthia matter clear$() — limpa matter do alvo$(br2)$(o)/liberthia reset$() — reseta player (sanity, infection, etc)$(br2)$(o)/liberthia spirit return$() — força return do spirit$(br2)$(o)/liberthia sound test <type>$() — toca cosmic sound$(br2)$(o)/liberthia hud sanity <subcommand>$() — config HUD

pages.title: Admin
pages.text: $(o)/liberthia admin$() — abre AdminToolScreen$(br2)$(o)/liberthia immortal <player>$() — imortalidade total$(br2)$(o)/liberthia bossfight <player> <name>$() — torna alvo em boss$(br2)$(o)/liberthia summon <entity>$() — invoca cosmic horror entities

pages.title: Sound test types
pages.text: $(o)whispers, eye_pulse, footsteps, breathing, radio, sky_hum, tendril, distortion, scream, audience, all$()$(br2)O comando $(o)all$() executa todos os 10 sons em 10s.
